items.v: No Crash Damage when Flying with Elytra

entries.text:
Allthemodium Armour
Allthemodium armour has several benefits other than just the armour, toughness and knockback resistance:
Water Breathing
No Crash Damage when Flying with Elytra
Immune to Fire Damage
No Fall Damage
When you upgrade the armour from Netherite, it keeps the enchants
Allthemodium Helmet Smithing
Allthemodium Chestplate Smithing
Allthemodium Leggings Smithing
Allthemodium Boots Smithing

entries.name: Allthemodium Ore

text.v: Allthemodium Ore spawns in the Deep Dark biome in cave walls and ceilings, you can also find it as a common spawn very high in the Mountains above 170Y, It can also be found everywhere in the mining dimension between Y -59 and Y 20. also Deepslate layer caves of the Other Dimension

entries.name: The Mining Dimension

text.v: The Mining Dimension is useful to set up quarries to mine in. It is also useful to use as a testing area since it is a superflat dimension. To teleport to the dimension use the

entries.name: The Other

text.v: The Other is a very hostile dimension. To teleport to the dimension use the
Teleport Pad

in the Nether. Little is known of this place, but it seems to be where Piglins come from, huge underground cities exist in any biomes with tree cover on the surface, as well as dungeons and ancient pyramids full of monsters and loot
